upgrade.name: Unannounced
upgrade.summary: No Polygon PoS upgrade after Lugano names both a bor release and a heimdall release. Lugano is already active.
upgrade.order_summary: No upgrade order between bor and heimdall is stated, because the next upgrade has not announced a pair.
upgrade.warning: Lugano activated on Polygon PoS mainnet on October 1, 2026 at Heimdall block 54,627,000. That announcement names Heimdall v0.12.1 and does not name a bor release. Bor v2.10.2 says it has no hardfork and does not name a heimdall release (https://github.com/0xPolygon/bor/releases/tag/v2.10.2). A bor release without the matching heimdall is not the next upgrade. Amoy is not this schedule.
